name: A proud mood fades a step, to happy, after 5 minutes
case: Boop is rooting for the agent (determined) when its tests fail once more and then pass, so it turns proud. It stays proud through a quick routine turn a minute later. Five minutes after it turned proud, the pride has faded a step: by the end of the next quick turn Boop is happy. Its faces no longer say proud: none, happy or calm at the turn's start, and at its finish, the third quick win of a streak, the same or the streak's rung, pleased or excited.
why: characters/boop/steering/mood/determined.md: a check passing after failing makes Boop proud, over a minute after it turned determined, since a mood holds while it's under a minute old; characters/boop/steering/mood/proud.md: proud stays through routine turns and fades a step toward calm, to happy, 5 minutes after the mood changed to it; the change shows, with a happy face, on whichever line brings it (the turn start or its finish); characters/boop/steering/personality/boop.md: a streak of quick wins is a ladder, its third rung excited, which a happy mood's faces lean to
